answer: Identity-bond decay blocks fake identities. Each agent posts a $50 bond at a mesa marker, decaying 5% per epoch unless it completes a peer-checked task. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns undiluted rewards. A forger with 1,000 identities must lock $50,000 and bleeds $2,500 per epoch unless it fakes 1,000 checked tasks, far above $3,000 gain. Clones sharing one ivory badge and the same pigment mark are flagged and frozen.
